To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the T2 values of the normal pediatric brain change with age.
the T2 relaxation time constant of normal pediatric brain increases from approximately 50 ms at 6 months of age to approximately 80 ms at 18 years of age.
the T2 relaxation times for white matter, gray matter and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) in the pediatric brain are age dependent, and are consistent with the known patterns of normal brain development.
